name: thapar-innovate-portal
description: Thapar Innovate Employee Portal - Monorepo root

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:sync: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,sync" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "node scripts/auto-sync.js"
